description: This file defines the internal interface IDhtGrainDirectory for distributed operations on grain directories in Orleans, including methods for registering, unregistering, deleting, and looking up grain addresses, as well as related data structures and enums.

classes.name: AddressAndTag
classes.description: Represents the address of a grain along with a version tag, used for directory entries.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation in the directory, optionally with a current registration, and returns the address and version tag.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Removes a specific grain activation from the directory, given its address and cause.

methods.name: UnregisterManyAsync
methods.description: Removes multiple grain addresses from the directory in a batch operation.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Removes all directory information about a specific grain ID.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Fetches complete directory information for a grain, querying remote nodes if necessary.
